title: 🧑🏽‍💻 About Me
content: I'm Alfredo Bonilla, a Full-Stack Developer with over 13 years of experience, specializing in AI-driven solutions and blockchain technologies.

My expertise includes TypeScript, React, Next.js, Solidity, and various blockchain frameworks. I'm passionate about building intuitive, scalable, and decentralized applications, particularly in the Web3 space.
I'm currently working at Dojo Coding, where I focus on developer advocacy, community growth, and supporting Web3 projects by fostering innovation and education.
I've worked on multiple Web3 projects, including Cofiblocks, Lago Finance, and Apy-Vision, where I've designed and built blockchain applications that enhance decentralization and user experience.

Beyond coding, I'm an active mentor, having taught over 1000 students about Web3 and blockchain. I've participated in various hackathons and hacker houses, contributing to projects like Semaphore Paymaster and OpenTribe.
When I'm not immersed in the world of Web3, you can find me sharing knowledge through podcasts, speaking at tech events, or creating educational content about AI, blockchain, and product development.
